points: The Q3 2026 earnings release expected around October 2026 will reveal whether revenue keeps shrinking after Q2 2026’s 2% YoY fall to $191.7 million, and the Q4 2026 guidance will show if the decline is already baked into the year-end outlook.
The Lifted enterprise platform is only a medium-strength driver, so if enterprise adoption does not accelerate by late 2026 and early 2027, Upwork will still depend on a shrinking SMB client pool.
The MCP server AI hiring integration launching in Q3 2026 may take several quarters to affect GSV, so the next few prints could still show weak headline numbers even if the product is well received.

RHI reports on November 3, 2026, about two months from now; if that peer also flags softer staffing demand, it would confirm the broader HR and employment-services slowdown and add pressure to Upwork around its own print.
GSV per active client rose 5% YoY for an eighth straight quarter, but if bigger clients pull back, that metric could flip negative and remove the main sign that remaining users are spending more.
